units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 8:7">Peah VIII, 7</cite> <he>פַּרְנָסַת לינה</he> the necessary arrangement for a night’s lodging (for the poor), expl.

<cite ref="Shabbat 118a">Sabb. 118ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q00344"><he>פּוּרְיָא</he></cite> II ch.; <cite ref="Bava Batra 9a">B. Bath. 9ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Peah 4:8">Tosef. Peah IV, 8</cite>.

<cite ref="Ketubot 50b:3">Keth. 50ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="G00558"><he>זן</he></cite> <cite ref="Ketubot 50b:3">ib.</cite>) <he>פ׳ הויא וכ׳</he> does this mean (bridal) outfit … or sustenance proper? <cite ref="Ketubot 50b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>התם לפ׳ הואי</he> there it was about the outfit.

<cite ref="Ketubot 68a">Ib. 68ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>לפ׳ שמון באב</he> as to the amount for which the heirs are to be assessed for a daughter’s outfit, we are guided by the disposition of her deceased father.

<cite ref="Ketubot 68a:9">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <he>מתפרנסות</he>, <cite ref="Ketubot 68a:9">ib.</cite>) <he>מאי לאו פרנסת הבעל</he> does it not mean the outfit for the husband (dower)? <he>לא בפרנסת עצמה</he> no, it refers to her own support.
<cite ref="Ketubot 68b:3">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>איבדו מזונותיהן ולא איבדו פַרְנָסָתָן</he> they have lost their claim on alimentation (from the estate), but not their claim on an outfit.
<cite ref="Berakhot 3b:29">Ber. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>עמך ישראל צריכין פ׳</he> Israel, thy people, need a living.
<cite ref="Taanit 9a:13">Taan. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>מטר … פ׳ בשביל רבים</he> rain is granted for the sake of an individual, support (prosperity) for the sake of the many (in public prayers).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:9">Gen. R. s. 20</cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 106">Midr. Till. to Ps. CVI</cite>, beg., v. <cite ref="Q00926"><he>פֶּלֶא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Taanit 19b:11">Taan. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>עבד שנתן לו רבו פַּרְנָסָתוֹ באחד וכ׳</he> a slave to whom his master gives his fare (for the week) on the first day of the week; a. v. fr.
